These Terms are an agreement between you and [Klean legal entity name], [address], Philippines ("Klean", "we", "us"). They apply to the Klean apps for iOS and Android, the Klean web app, and related services (the "Service"). By creating an account or using the Service, you agree to these Terms and to our Privacy Policy.

1. Who can use Klean

1.1 You must be at least 18 years old, or the age of majority where you live, and able to enter a binding contract.

1.2 One person, one account. Each person may hold only one Klean account. That one account is used for every role you have on Klean: customer, staff member, business owner. Creating or using a second account, sharing an account, or using someone else's account is prohibited. We may merge, suspend or close duplicate accounts.

1.3 Identity verification is required for everyone. Before using Klean you must verify your identity through our verification provider, Didit, using a valid government-issued ID and a live selfie. There are no exemptions, including for staff, business owners and Klean's own personnel.

1.4 Verification fee. Each verification attempt costs a fee, which covers the cost of the identity check. The price is shown before you pay:

  • In the iPhone/iPad app: an in-app purchase through Apple (US$2.99, ₱199 in the Philippines, or the App Store's price for your country), charged to your Apple account under Apple's terms.
  • In the Android app: an in-app purchase through Google Play, at the price Google Play shows for your country.
  • On klean.ph: US$2.99 by card, or ₱199 by GCash, Maya or QR Ph.

The fee is charged per attempt, is paid to Klean, and is non-refundable (including if verification is declined or finds that you already have an account), except where the law or the App Store's / Google Play's own refund rules say otherwise; refunds for in-app purchases are handled by Apple or Google. Resuming an unfinished attempt is free. A refunded or reversed fee may void the attempt it paid for. We may change the fee for future attempts.

2. Your account

2.1 You sign in with Apple, Google or GitHub. You're responsible for keeping those accounts secure and for all activity under your Klean account.

2.2 Your member code is a public identifier you may share so that a business can hire you or credit points to you. It can't be used to sign in or make payments.

2.3 You may delete your account at any time in the app (Account → Delete account). Deletion is permanent. Unused points and load credits are forfeited. We keep records we're legally required to keep, as described in the Privacy Policy.

3. Using laundromats on Klean (customers)

3.1 Operators. Laundromats on Klean are run by independent businesses ("Operators"). Each Operator sets its own prices, operates its own premises and machines, and is responsible for its laundry services. Klean provides the software and payment processing; Klean is not the laundromat.

3.2 Payment before use. A machine is activated only after your payment is confirmed by the payment provider. Prices are shown before you pay. One "load" means one wash and one dry, up to the Operator's maximum weight.

3.3 Load credits. If you've paid but the machine you selected can't be activated, the load is kept as a credit in your wallet, usable on any available machine of the same Operator. Load credits expire 30 days after purchase and have no cash value.

3.4 Points. Operators may offer loyalty points ("Klean Points"). Points are earned and redeemable only with the Operator where they were earned (at any of its branches). They have no cash value, can't be transferred or sold, expire as shown in the app (currently 12 months after they're earned), and may be reversed if the underlying payment is refunded or was fraudulent. Each Operator sets and funds its own program and may change it for the future; points already earned keep their value until they expire.

3.5 Problems with a wash. Report machine problems to the Operator's staff. Klean returns credits automatically when a machine fails to start after payment. Questions about laundry quality, damage or lost items are between you and the Operator.

4. Running a laundromat on Klean (Operators)

4.1 Operator mode. A verified user may create an Operator account and becomes its Super Admin. You must have authority to bind the business you register.

4.2 Payments and payouts. You appoint Klean as your limited agent to collect payments from customers for laundry services at your business. A customer's payment to Klean counts as payment to you. Customers pay Klean through its payment partners (PayMongo for businesses in the Philippines, Stripe elsewhere), and Klean pays your business its share automatically, normally once a day, to the payout account you set up (in the Philippines, a GCash, Maya or bank account in the Super Admin's verified name; elsewhere, a Stripe account whose onboarding you complete). Payouts below a minimum amount roll over to the next day. You may not accept payments for Klean-connected machines outside the Service, or bypass the Service to activate machines.

4.3 Commission. For each payment processed through the Service, Klean charges a commission at the rate shown in your dashboard (currently [5]% of the amount paid). The commission is kept automatically by Klean; your payout is the amount paid less the commission, the payment partner's processing fees, and any payout transfer fee (currently ₱10 per payout in the Philippines). Only Klean can set or change the commission rate. Each transaction is charged at the rate in effect when the checkout was opened. We'll give you at least 30 days' notice of any increase. Free loads redeemed with points, and welcome loads you choose to offer new members, carry no commission. Downloading and setting up Klean is free; there's no subscription fee.

4.4 Your obligations. You're responsible for: your prices; keeping machines safe and in working order; honoring load credits and points issued by your business; issuing official receipts and paying taxes as required by law (in the Philippines, including BIR requirements); handling customer complaints about your services; and your staff's conduct.

4.4a Machine controllers. If you connect machines to Klean with a controller (bought or self-built from our hardware guide), you're responsible for installing it safely and lawfully, including having a licensed electrician do any work on electrical supply, and for any effect on your machines' warranties. The hardware guide and controller software are provided as-is, as guidance. Keep controller files private: anyone with a machine's secret key can act as that machine. Klean HQ's simulated machines are for testing; don't take real customers' payments on a simulated machine.

4.4b Beta mode. Every business starts in Beta. In Beta, payments use test money only (no real money is charged or paid out), simulated machines may be used, and the Super Admin can delete the business's beta orders, test customers and points at any time. To take real payments you must switch Beta off, which requires Klean to be accepting real payments, a payout account, and at least one real machine connected with a Klean controller. Switching Beta off deletes all beta data. Real sales records can't be deleted (see the Privacy Policy on retention).

4.5 Staff. You may grant staff access only to verified Klean users, by their member code. You're responsible for removing access when someone stops working for you.

4.6 Customer data. You may use customer information shown in your dashboard only to operate your laundromat and in line with the Privacy Policy and applicable data protection law. You may not export it for unrelated marketing, sell it, or attempt to identify customers beyond what the Service shows.

4.7 Suspension. We may suspend an Operator's ability to take payments for fraud, unresolved disputes, legal requirements, or material breach of these Terms, with notice where the law and circumstances allow.

5. The Service requires an internet connection

The Service works only online. Payments, machine activation and records require a live connection. When your device is offline the app is locked until it reconnects. Klean isn't responsible for losses caused by your internet connection or your premises' network.

6. Acceptable use

You must not: create multiple accounts or help others do so; submit false identity information; tamper with machines, controllers or QR codes; attempt to obtain wash cycles without paying; reverse-engineer, scrape or overload the Service; misuse other users' data; or use the Service for anything illegal.

7. Fees, refunds and chargebacks

7.1 Laundry payments are made to the Operator through Klean. Refund requests for laundry services go to the Operator, who decides in line with law and their policies. Klean may issue refunds where the Service itself failed (e.g. a double charge).

7.2 If a payment is refunded or charged back, related points and credits may be reversed. Klean's commission on a refunded payment is handled as set out in the Operator's payment-partner terms and our fee schedule [to be defined].

8. Availability and changes

We work to keep the Service available but don't guarantee it will be uninterrupted or error-free. We may change, add or remove features, and we may require you to update the app to keep using the Service (older versions may stop working, for example after a security or payment change). We may update these Terms; if a change is material, we'll notify you in the app at least [15] days before it takes effect. Continuing to use the Service after that means you accept the change.

9. Liability

9.1 To the extent permitted by law, the Service is provided "as is". Klean isn't liable for the laundry services of Operators, for indirect or consequential losses, or for losses caused by events beyond our reasonable control.

9.2 To the extent permitted by law, Klean's total liability to you for any claim is limited to the greater of (a) the fees you paid to Klean in the 12 months before the claim, or (b) [₱5,000].

9.3 Nothing in these Terms limits rights you have under consumer protection law (including the Consumer Act of the Philippines and the Internet Transactions Act, RA 11967) that can't be limited by contract.

10. Ending the agreement

You can stop using Klean and delete your account at any time. We may suspend or close your account for breach of these Terms, fraud, legal requirements, or to protect other users, with notice where appropriate.
